strategy.name: nasdaq100_strategy1_rotation_fast_exit_selection_rebalance_factorial
strategy.description: 在2005至2010年的历史时点Nasdaq-100成分中，对每只证券独立运行冻结的Strategy1，并把完成Close后的股票仓位作为分数。正式12格由快速退出开关、Top20且分数严格高于90%/全部高于90%/全部高于80%三种选股范围，以及每两日恢复等权/每两日只处理进出而让存量漂移两种资金管理完整交叉。普通名单在每两个XNYS交易日的Close确认并于下一Open成交；快速退出严格沿用父诊断，在持仓跨日时StochRSI100由不低于0.80真下穿至0.80以下的当日Close全卖，并在母Strategy1仓位严格低于20%前锁定。另报告历史时点全部成分每两日等权和同期QQQ Buy & Hold两个基准。候选历史成分与行情仍为pending_review，因此结果只作探索性证据。
strategy.buy_rule: 每个两日决策Close使用滞后一交易日已知的成分身份。TOP20_90先保留母Strategy1仓位严格高于0.90者，再按仓位降序和security_id升序取最多20只；ALL_90保留全部严格高于0.90者；ALL_80保留全部严格高于0.80者。开启快速退出时，仍处于快速退出锁的证券不能买入；锁只在该证券完成Close后的母仓位严格低于0.20时解除。普通入选决定在下一有效Open买入。
strategy.sell_rule: 每个两日决策Close重新确定名单，不再入选或已离开滞后时点成分集合的持仓在下一有效Open卖出。RESTORE_EQUAL会同时把继续入选者恢复为等权；ENTRY_EXIT_ONLY只卖出离开者并用执行Open卖出后实际可用现金平均买入新进入者，不为继续入选者主动调权。FAST开启时，只对前一Close已持有的证券，若StochRSI100由上一完成值不低于0.80变为当日完成值低于0.80，则在穿越当日Close全卖并设置锁；当天Open才新买入的证券不触发同日快速退出。
strategy.signal_time: 母Strategy1分数、StochRSI100穿越、名单和目标均只使用拆股及股息调整后的完成Close与此前信息；成分身份统一使用前一XNYS交易日已观察到的状态。
strategy.execution_time: 普通名单变化和RESTORE_EQUAL目标在决策Close确认后于下一有效调整Open先卖后买；快速退出在真下穿当日调整Close成交并优先于该Close产生的下一期名单。每条路径分别使用单边0或5bps不利冲击，允许小数股。
strategy.positioning: 全部路径从10万美元现金开始，不融资、不做空、现金不计息。RESTORE_EQUAL在每次两日决策后把100%可配置资金等分给当期入选股；ENTRY_EXIT_ONLY保留继续入选者的原股份，只把退出所得和既有现金平均投入新进入者，若没有新进入者则现金保留。没有入选证券时持有现金。

plain_language.summary: 检验Strategy1高仓位信号在2005至2010年用于历史纳指成分轮动时，扩大候选范围、减少调权和快速退出分别有什么作用。
plain_language.buy: 每两天从当时已知的纳指成分中选出分数达标的股票，按不同版本取前二十只或全部买入；快速退出留下的锁必须先解除。
plain_language.sell: 股票不再入选时在下一开盘卖出；快速版本还会在长周期指标从高位向下穿过0.80时于当天收盘立即退出。
plain_language.execution: 普通排名在收盘后确认并于下一开盘先卖后买，快速退出则保留上一版的穿越当天收盘成交。
plain_language.position: 一种版本每两天恢复等权，另一种只处理名单进出并让旧仓自然漂移；同时与全成分等权和QQQ长期持有比较。

signal_engine.score: post-trade Strategy1 equity weight in each security at completed Close

fast_exit.cross: previous completed StochRSI100 greater than or equal to 0.80 and current completed StochRSI100 strictly below 0.80
fast_exit.eligible_position: shares carried from the previous Close only

allocation_modes.RESTORE_EQUAL: at every scheduled decision, resize all selected holdings to equal target weights
allocation_modes.ENTRY_EXIT_ONLY: at every scheduled decision, sell deselected holdings, preserve continuing shares, and divide actual available execution-Open cash equally among newly selected securities

parameters.baseline2_definition: every two trading days equal-weight every lagged point-in-time Nasdaq-100 member with a valid signal Close and next Open
parameters.baseline3_definition: buy QQQ at the first executable Open and hold through the final Close
parameters.same_session_priority: scheduled Open changes execute first; a fast exit may act at that Close only for shares carried from the previous Close; lock reset follows the Close exit; the resulting lock participates in that Close's next scheduled selection
parameters.temporary_unavailability_policy: a holding or requested change with no real signal Close or next execution Open is frozen until a later scheduled decision with real bars; no buy may use a synthetic carry bar
parameters.terminal_price_policy: a final adjusted bar may be carried only to settle an existing holding at a later scheduled Open; it cannot receive a new positive target

financing: disabled; virtual Strategy1 contributions never enter the tradable portfolio; cash earns zero
benchmark: Two explicit baselines are reported at both costs: lagged point-in-time Nasdaq-100 all-member equal weight rebalanced every two sessions, and same-window QQQ Buy & Hold. All paths share the same initial cash and analysis calendar.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse the shared v5 renderer; add experiment-specific factorial controls, equity/drawdown/exposure panels, cost and pairwise-effect tables, eligible-count diagnostics, and explicit benchmark toggles without exposing raw configuration on the front page.

research.hypothesis: The prior Top20 rotation may have lost information by capping the eligible set, overtraded by restoring equal weights, and exited weakening stocks too slowly. A complete fixed factorial over candidate breadth, rebalancing, and the retained fast exit can identify whether any improvement is broad rather than a single hand-picked variant.
research.primary_metric: At 5bps compare full-window CAGR, Sharpe, Sortino, maximum drawdown, annual volatility, turnover, order count, exposure, holdings count and QQQ/baseline1 excess return across all 12 paths; use 0bps to attribute friction and pair every fast-exit state against its otherwise identical control.
research.selection_rule: Run and display every predeclared 2 by 3 by 2 cell. Baseline1 is FAST0_TOP20_90_REBAL; baseline2 and QQQ are comparisons rather than selectable winners. Do not rename the highest 2005-2010 path as future-optimal, and do not change thresholds, period, lock reset, execution timing, or no-rebalance sizing after seeing results.
research.validation_plan: Regression-test the exact Strategy1 score and prior fast-exit crossing/reset contract, test all 12 unique case definitions, threshold breadth, point-in-time membership lag, top20 tie-break, scheduled equal-weight restoration, entry/exit-only drift, same-day event priority and both baselines. Reconcile every portfolio between PyBroker scheduled fills and an independent cash/share/FIFO ledger within 1e-6, then run the full suite, report tests, real Chrome interaction, PDF print gates, catalog checks, workspace audit and validate_run.
research.promotion_criteria: No path can be promoted while the Nasdaq-100 package is pending_review. A follow-up candidate should improve both CAGR and Sharpe versus baseline1 at 5bps, not worsen maximum drawdown materially, preserve direction at 0bps, show a coherent main effect rather than one isolated interaction, and later survive a separately frozen period with approved data.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject any current-constituent lookback, same-Close ordinary ranking fill, non-strict 80/90 gate, simple below-0.80 rule instead of a true downcross, fast exit applied to same-day new shares, lock release at equality, mother-state reset by the outer portfolio, future membership or price availability in selection, silent concentration or redistribution, omitted factorial cells or poor baselines, financing, synthetic-bar buys, ledger mismatch, or presentation of pending_review candidate data as formal evidence.
